**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document sits at the **preferred** position for MINCOMMIT:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** — expressly states "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," ties fees to Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and confirms that declining to place a further order "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** — Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume (or exclusivity / non-compete / MFC / no-hire) commitment, and nothing restricts our sourcing or business activity.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars Vendor from imposing any platform, support, administration or **minimum-use** charge not identified in the Order Form, closing the back-door minimum route.

Confirmed the only other "shortfall" hits (**§§ 22.2–22.3**) concern audited underpayment for actual usage, not take-or-pay, and there are no volume caps on our usage. Nothing to redline.
